subject: How to let shiny render different numbers of tableoutputs, based on reactive input?

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: How to let shiny render different numbers of tableoutputs, based on reactive input?
parts:
My shiny app generates a list of dataframes, based on reactive input. The number of dataframes differs. For showing the dataframes in the ui of my shiny app I want to use tableOutput(). Would there be a way of interactively showing different numbers of tableoutputs based on reactive input?

Many thanks in advance!
